crossRefs.note: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
crossRefs.keyword: book. or, letter. that is sealed

crossRefs.note: But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and…
He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father…
I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice…

translations.web: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”
translations.bsb: And the entire vision will be to you like the words sealed in a scroll. If it is handed to someone to read, he will say, “I cannot, because it is sealed.”
translations.kjv: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
translations.asv: And all vision is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee; and he saith, I cannot, for it is sealed:
